title: When was the last time…?

fn.en: Talk about finished actions and say when they happened.

useful: When was the last time you…?

items.q: We ___ house last year — from a flat to a small house.
I ___ an email from my boss this morning.
She ___ a meal for eight people on Saturday.
I ___ for the bus for half an hour.
Last summer we ___ my grandmother in Kenya.
It started to rain, so I ___ a taxi.

sub.en: Look at the verbs. What happens to the spelling before -ed?

items.why: The verb already ends in -e, so you add only -d.
vowel + y → just add -ed: played, stayed.
One short vowel + one consonant → double the consonant.
British English doubles the l: travelled, cancelled.

items.from: I walk to work every day.

items.a: We travelled by train last week
They arrived at six o’clock two days ago
He stayed in a hotel at the weekend

items.from: I cook dinner for my family.
items.a: I cooked dinner for my family last Monday

items.s: I cooked for eight people ___ the weekend. 🎉
___ was the last time you posted a letter? ✉️
I called my sister ___ — on Tuesday evening. 📞

tts: When was the last time you moved house? In 2010. From an apartment to a house.
When was the last time you received an email? This morning. It was from my boss.
When was the last time you prepared a meal? Last night. I cooked spaghetti for my housemate.
When was the last time you posted a letter? A month ago. It was to my friend in Australia.
When was the last time you visited a relative? Last summer. I travelled to Kenya to see my grandmother.

use: When was the last time you…?

items.sit: Someone asks when you last moved house. It was in 2019.
You phoned your mother on Tuesday. Today is Thursday.
o: I called her two days ago.
I called her two days before.
I call her two days ago.

items.sit: You cooked a big meal on Saturday.
o: I cooked a big meal at the weekend.
I cooked a big meal in the weekend.
I cook a big meal at the weekend.

items.sit: You want to know when your colleague last studied English.
o: When was the last time you studied English?
When was the last time you study English?
When were the last time you studied English?

items.sit: You waited half an hour for the bus this morning.
o: I waited for half an hour.
I waitted for half an hour.
I was waited for half an hour.

items.sit: You went to Turkey by plane last summer.
o: I travelled to Turkey last summer.
I was travelled to Turkey last summer.
I travel to Turkey last summer.

lines.s: When ___ the last time you moved house? 📦
We ___ two years ago. From a flat to a small house.
They moved ___ year, to my home town.
Did they call you about it?
Yes — I ___ a photo of the new kitchen. 📥
And my mother ___ a big meal for everybody. 🍳

write.q: Answer for you: when was the last time you moved house, cooked a meal, travelled by train, called an old friend and waited a long time? Write 5 sentences with a past time expression in each.
write.model: I moved house three years ago. I cooked a big meal last Saturday. I travelled by train in 2019 — it was a long journey. I called an old friend last night. I waited forty minutes for the bus yesterday morning.

speak.q: Ask and answer out loud: When was the last time you cooked a meal? …you visited a relative? …you posted a letter? Give a past time expression in every answer.
speak.model: When was the last time you cooked a meal? — I cooked yesterday evening. When was the last time you visited a relative? — Last summer. I travelled to Taraz to see my grandmother.
